sources.title: YOLO-World: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (Cheng et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: RepVL-PAN (re-parameterizable vision-language aggregation) + region-text contrastive loss bring open-vocabulary detection into the YOLO operating point; LVIS 35.4 AP at 52 FPS (V100) zero-shot; fine-tuned variants extend to detection and open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

Stated trade-off: fine-tuning on O365/LVIS-style closed vocabularies can degrade zero-shot generalization (CLIP generalization eroded by 365-category fine-tuning); pre-training with fine-annotated + pseudo-annotated data combination performs better — an X01 data-contract finding.
claims.context: Paper's limitation/discussion passages consumed; supports the supervision-contract reading.

limitations.text: YOLO product-line confusion risk; version-bound claims only; edge-deployment burden noted as motivation, not established result.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
